description_en: Confirms or rejects a pending operation in an Alibaba Cloud ApsaraDB agent session
description_zh: 确认或拒绝瑶池数据库Agent会话中的待执行操作
kebab_example: aliyun das create-yao-chi-agent-confirm --confirmation-id 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000 --approved true --session-id a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4789-abcd-0123456789ab --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateYaoChiAgentConfirm

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the pending operation. Use the confirmation_id returned by the operation confirmation event in the ApsaraDB agent session. Do not generate it yourself. The value is a 36-character UUID with hyphens, in the format of xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
parameters.help_zh: 待确认操作的唯一标识。请使用瑶池数据库Agent会话中操作确认事件返回的 confirmation_id，不要自行生成。格式为36个字符的UUID，包含连字符，形如 xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
parameters.name: confirmation_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to approve the execution of the pending operation. Valid values:

true: Approve the execution.
false: Reject the execution.

This parameter is required. A rejection is also a valid confirmation response and does not indicate an API call failure
parameters.help_zh:
是否同意执行待确认操作。取值：

true：同意执行。
false：拒绝执行。

该参数必填；拒绝也是有效的确认响应，不代表接口调用失败
parameters.name: approved

parameters.help_en: The session ID of the ApsaraDB agent session to which the pending operation belongs. It must be the same as the SessionId used when creating the session and initiating the chat, and must correspond to the session to which the ConfirmationId belongs. The format is a 36-character UUID with hyphens
parameters.help_zh: 待确认操作所属的瑶池数据库Agent会话ID，必须与创建会话、发起聊天时使用的 SessionId 一致，并与 ConfirmationId 所属的会话对应。格式为36个字符的UUID，包含连字符
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The custom parameters of the tool. The example shows the parameter structure of the tool for modifying instance descriptions. The instance ID and description are desensitized and provided only for format reference. The current version does not support modifying tool parameters through this operation. Omit this parameter in actual calls and do not pass an empty string or a JSON string. When approving the execution, the original tool parameters generated by the assistant are used
parameters.help_zh: 工具自定义参数。示例展示修改实例描述工具的参数结构，实例ID和描述均已脱敏，仅供格式参考。当前版本暂不支持通过本接口修改工具参数，实际调用请省略该参数，不要传入空字符串或JSON字符串。同意执行时使用助理生成的原始工具参数
parameters.name: tool_args

Approved.description_en: The confirmation decision submitted in this request, which is the same as the Approved request parameter. A value of true indicates that the execution is approved, and false indicates that the execution is rejected. It does not indicate whether the tool operation is executed successfully
Approved.description_zh: 本次提交的确认决定，与请求参数 Approved 一致。true 表示同意执行，false 表示拒绝执行；不表示工具操作是否执行成功

ConfirmationId.description_en: The operation identifier for the submitted confirmation, which is the same as the ConfirmationId request parameter
ConfirmationId.description_zh: 本次提交确认的操作标识，与请求参数 ConfirmationId 一致

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查和日志追踪

Status.description_en: The status string. The example value success refers to the outer success status of the downstream confirmation callback response and is provided only for format demonstration. It does not mean that the Status field of the current operation actually returns this value. In the current version, this field may be empty or not returned. Do not rely on this field to determine whether the execution is approved or whether the tool is executed successfully
Status.description_zh: 状态字符串。示例值success参考下游确认回调响应外层的成功状态，仅供格式展示，不代表当前接口的Status字段已实际返回该值。当前版本该字段可能为空或不返回，请勿依赖该字段判断是否同意执行或工具是否执行成功

ToolArgsReceived.description_en: Specifies whether custom tool parameters are received. A value of true indicates that non-null parameters are provided, and false indicates that no parameters are provided. It does not indicate whether the parameters are applied or whether the tool is executed successfully. In the current version, omit the ToolArgs request parameter, and this field normally returns false
ToolArgsReceived.description_zh: 是否接收到自定义工具参数。true 表示提供了非null的参数，false 表示未提供；不代表参数已应用或工具执行成功。当前版本请省略请求参数 ToolArgs，正常返回 false
